info.title: Product analytics and Admin API
info.description: Separate platform authority. TiDB Cloud OIDC with a verified pingcap.com email is required for Admin. Workspace Keys and personal Owner sessions grant no access. Business actions use native outcomes; browser events are untrusted. HTTP monitoring is excluded.

post.description: Untrusted optional browser events only. Exact trusted Origin and application/json required; no account or Workspace authorization is established. 202 acknowledges queued acceptance by the independent analytics service, not object-storage durability. Queued writes may be lost on a crash. Retained event IDs deduplicate retries. GPC suppression returns 204.
